title: Add whole-work-item reference migration command
objective: Implement sdlc ref migrate-work-item-up --work-item <work-item-id> as a bounded, deterministic whole-work-item reference migration command, validate it with isolated fixtures and read-only failure checks, then release version 0.6.0 by pushing main to origin.

branch.name: WI-0028-migrate-work-item-up
branch.rationale: Implementation and validation will use a dedicated context branch before merging into main and publishing the 0.6.0 release.

request.text:
Prepare a .docs/work-items/* to implement a sdlc ref migrate-work-item-up --work-item <work-item-id>.

Commit the work item.

Process the new work item, making a commit for each task until the work item is completed.

Perform release by pushing to the origin and incrementing a minor version.

scope.name: whole-work-item-command
scope.description: Add sdlc ref migrate-work-item-up --work-item <work-item-id> as the explicit command for migrating one complete work-item directory.
scope.reason: Callers need a named whole-work-item migration boundary instead of relying on path-oriented or task-local command variants.

scope.name: bounded-migration-report
scope.description: Migrate work-item.json and supported files below the selected work-item directory while reporting deterministic files, replacements, unresolvable references, and findings.
scope.reason: Whole-work-item migration must remain auditable, idempotent, and isolated from sibling records.

scope.name: fixture-and-read-only-validation
scope.description: Exercise valid, invalid, missing, conflicting, unresolvable, repeated, and sibling-isolation cases with unchanged-file assertions on failure paths.
scope.reason: The command mutates selected records and needs explicit safety evidence at the command boundary.

scope.name: minor-release-publication
scope.description: Increment the package minor version from 0.5.0 to 0.6.0, verify the compiled launcher, and push main to origin after all task gates pass.
scope.reason: The request explicitly includes release publication and a minor version increment.

nonGoals.name: arbitrary-path-migration
nonGoals.description: Do not add a path selector or allow the new command to migrate content outside .docs/work-items/<work-item-id>/.
nonGoals.reason: The requested command is intentionally work-item scoped.

nonGoals.name: remote-work-item-migration
nonGoals.description: Do not contact or mutate remote repositories during migration.
nonGoals.reason: Migration remains a local deterministic filesystem operation.

nonGoals.name: automatic-invalid-reference-repair
nonGoals.description: Do not invent canonical targets for unresolvable references; preserve them and report the reason.
nonGoals.reason: Safe migration requires explicit resolution evidence.

nonGoals.name: release-tagging
nonGoals.description: Do not create a Git tag as part of this release unless a later request explicitly requires one.
nonGoals.reason: The request requires pushing to origin and incrementing a minor version, but does not request tagging.

items.name: command-selection
items.description: sdlc ref migrate-work-item-up --work-item <work-item-id> must accept one valid work-item ID and select exactly the corresponding .docs/work-items/<id>/ directory.
items.reason: The requested command needs a stable, explicit whole-work-item entry point.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A valid work-item ID migrates work-item.json and all supported files below the selected directory and does not modify sibling work items.
Missing, malformed, unknown, duplicate, and conflicting options return stable non-zero diagnostics without writes.

items.name: migration-contract
items.description: The command must reuse the established reference migration semantics and emit a versioned whole-work-item response with deterministic scope, changed files, replacements, unresolvable entries, and findings.
items.reason: Existing task-local migration behavior and machine-readable reporting must remain consistent while adding the new command boundary.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Resolvable legacy references migrate to their canonical targets; unresolvable references remain byte-for-byte unchanged and are reported with context and reason.
Repeated migration is a no-op with deterministic output, and the response validates against the persisted work-item migration schema.

items.name: safety-and-test-coverage
items.description: Implementation and validation must cover command help/errors, full work-item scope, sibling isolation, malformed content, read-only failure paths, and complete repository gates.
items.reason: The command mutates a bounded record tree and must be safe for coding-agent use.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Isolated fixtures cover valid migration, no-op repeat, unresolvable preservation, invalid/missing work items, and sibling isolation.
The selected fixture and unrelated files remain unchanged when selection or parsing fails, and every task records a passing full test gate.

items.name: minor-release-and-push
items.description: After implementation and validation pass, increment the package minor version from 0.5.0 to 0.6.0, verify the compiled CLI reports 0.6.0, and push main to origin.
items.reason: The user explicitly requested a minor release and origin publication.

acceptanceCriteria.description: package.json reports 0.6.0, node ./bin/cli.js --version reports 0.6.0 after build, final gates pass, and origin/main contains the release commit.

items.name: task-commit-gates
items.description: Each implementation, validation, and delivery task must be committed separately with its required evidence and passing gates.
items.reason: The command, persisted migration behavior, package version, and remote publication cross distinct delivery boundaries.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every task result records its completed validation procedure, and the completed work item validates with zero invalid objects and zero unresolved references.
